# External Relations Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the External Relations department in the whole system: how well PR, media production, crisis communications, fundraising, and external partnerships hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- PR releases and media kits
- Media production and coverage
- Crisis communications
- Fundraising and investor relations support
- External partnerships and community

## What is in place
- [ ] Releases and reports that can be checked against their media source
- [ ] Crisis plan with scenarios and a named owner
- [ ] Fundraising materials where every claim has a source
- [ ] Coverage tracked per release
- [ ] Record of releases, coverage, and partnerships in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] Releases that cannot be checked against a source
- [ ] Crisis plan with no scenario or no owner
- [ ] Fundraising claims with no evidence behind them
- [ ] Coverage untracked after a release goes out
- [ ] External relationships living in scattered notes

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real release or fundraising step and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
